// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the user.
Tenant* (xref:#entidad-tenant[Tenant])::
Tenant the user belongs to.
Name* (string)::
User name entered on the sign-in screen.
Password* (string)::
Password of the user when the sign-in is not delegated to an identity provider; only its hash is stored.
Email (string)::
Email used to send notifications to the user.
Welcome at (datetime)::
When the welcome email was sent.
Email verified (boolean)::
Indicates whether the user has confirmed ownership of their email address by clicking the verification link sent at registration. Used by the OIDC flow to emit the email_verified claim and optionally block login until confirmed.
Enabled (boolean)::
A disabled user cannot sign in; on each attempt the user is told that the account is disabled.
Approval status (UserApprovalStatusOptions)::
Approval state of the account: email not verified yet, pending approval by an administrator, accepted or rejected.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * UNVERIFIED
 * PENDING
 * ACCEPTED
 * REJECTED

Temporal password (boolean)::
The password is temporary: the user must set a new one at the next sign-in.
Use second factors (boolean)::
The user signs in with a one-time password (TOTP) as second factor.
Second factor seed (string)::
Secret seed of the one-time password generator; stored encrypted.
Blocked until (datetime)::
A blocked user cannot sign in until this date; on each attempt the user gets a generic not-allowed message.
Federated provider (string)::
Identity provider the user signed up with, kept even if the provider changes later.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de user para controlar bloqueos optimistas
